svg.text: Online exam and assignment platform: AWS architecture (one Region, two Availability Zones)
one ALB with a node in each AZ
IA 30 d → Glacier 1 yr → delete 5 yr
daily, kept 5 years, copy to 2nd Region
Flow 1 (open exam, autosave): Student → Route 53 → WAF → CloudFront → ALB → Fargate task → Redis/Aurora (exam) and DynamoDB (autosave).
Flow 2 (upload): API returns a presigned URL → browser uploads straight to S3 → EventBridge → SQS → notify-fn → Aurora (via RDS Proxy) + SES email to tutor.

Colours: purple = edge · blue = network · orange = compute · green = data · pink = messaging · red = security · grey = operations. Green arrow = autosave to DynamoDB; pink arrow = queue triggers notify-fn. Databases have no public address.
